svg.text: 18650 -> IP5306 module -> ESP32 VIN; divider to D33 reads the battery. USB cable NOT plugged in.
D33 sees half the cell voltage
Charging: remove the 5V+ wire to the ESP32,
then plug a charger into the Type-C port.
Never connect USB and the 5V+ wire together.
K pad: leave free (touch to GND ~1 s only to wake).
